verses.text: So, brothers and sisters, because of God's mercy, I urge you to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice—holy and pleasing to God. This is your true and proper worship.
Don't let this age shape you. Instead, be transformed by a renewed mind, so you can recognize what God wants—what is good, pleasing, and complete.
By the grace given to me, I tell everyone among you: don't think of yourself more highly than you should. Think clearly and soberly, as God has given each person a measure of faith.
Just as one body has many parts, and those parts don't all have the same job,
so we, though many, are one body in Christ, and each of us belongs to one another.
We have different gifts according to the grace God has given us. If your gift is prophecy, use it in keeping with your faith.
If it's serving, then serve; if it's teaching, then teach.
If it's encouraging, then encourage; if it's giving, give generously; if it's leading, lead diligently; if it's showing mercy, do it cheerfully.
Let your love be real. Hate what is evil; hold tightly to what is good.
Love each other like family. Take the lead in showing honor to one another.
Don't lose your drive. Stay spiritually fired up as you serve the Lord.
Be joyful in hope, patient in trouble, and faithful in prayer.
Share with God's people who are in need. Make hospitality a habit.
Bless those who persecute you—bless them, don't curse them.
Celebrate with those who celebrate; mourn with those who mourn.
Live in harmony with one another. Don't chase status; be willing to spend time with people others overlook. Don't act like you know it all.
Don't pay anyone back with evil. Do what everyone can see is good.
If possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
Dear friends, don't take revenge. Leave room for God's anger, because Scripture says, ‘Vengeance is mine; I will repay, says the Lord.’
Instead, ‘If your enemy is hungry, feed them; if they're thirsty, give them something to drink. By doing this, you'll heap burning coals on their head.’
Don't let evil defeat you. Defeat evil by doing good.
